keyFindings.description: GitHub reports the PR CONFLICTING with main aeeee6c0 (packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md, renamed by #2419). Merge main forward (no rebase) and move the two entries into changie fragments made with `changie new --custom Issue=pr2414` in packages/envoy; no Dispatch key in fragment names, fields, entry text or new commit subjects (architect's required change, 10:30Z).

Main's #2368 adds permanentListeners = 3 (naming the deleted stale-room evictor) and ConnectionsPerProcess, and infra/gcp/dispatch.go dispatchConnectionsPerPod = 83 with TestDispatchConnectionsPerPodIsTheServers requiring equality. This branch has four listener-pool connections and leasePoolSize 11 (85). After the merge, set permanentListeners to 4 with a true comment, dispatchConnectionsPerPod to 85, and re-check the infra README's max_connections sizing text.

Closing an issue now drops a person's edits that were queued but not yet stored when the close committed: rooms close later on the trigger's notification, CloseRoom(room, true) flushes the queue into the append gate, the gate refuses appendBrowser on a closed issue (pending_authors.go:538), and StoreUpdateContext returns nil (websocket.go:160-163; service.go:2514-2525 says they are dropped). At base, patchIssue closed the rooms itself after commit and no append was refused, so those edits were stored. Contradicts 'never worse'. Needs a fix and a failing-before/passing-after test.

admitConditionalEdit takes a shared-pool connection (Pool.Begin, :878) and waits on the per-document advisory lock while holding it, before any cross-process refusal; gate.write is taken only after. Base refused or queued in memory before any connection ('keeping stale retries from exhausting pgx'). A retry storm on one document can hold all 64 shared connections. Serialize admissions per document in memory before Begin.

30 new Dispatch keys (INFRA-<n>) in file contents: code comments, test comments, migrations, AGENTS.md, README, CHANGELOG. The standing rule 'Stop new leaks only' (dispatch://INFRA-472, relayed 2026-10-27) forbids new keys in file contents, test names, PR title and body, and commit messages on sjawhar/legion. Remove them, and from the PR body (Why line, Notes).

No '## Contract change census' although the PR adds refusals at a process boundary: a browser append on a closed issue is refused, a rebuild is refused 409 DOCUMENT_LIVE when a room is resident on another process, and the conditional-edit cap now refuses 429 across processes.

Docs criterion: false statements. Redial wait 'up to 30 s' is up to 45 s (pglisten.RedialBackoff adds up to half); X-Dispatch-Process is not on the 400 refusals from refuseUnstorableParameters/refuseUnstorableActor; AGENTS.md:102-103 still says rooms behind the head close; AGENTS.md:1193-1194 still calls the conditional gate in-memory; AGENTS.md:46 pglisten row names a removed wake and several Hub users; rollout text omits that earlier-build processes ignore closes and reopens; 'any process' is 'any member that answers'; '500 ms at most' is per question, up to three per write; 'nobody is disconnected' and 'closed only when its history is replaced' are absolute claims the issue close and failRoom contradict; running-dispatch.md says the fourth connection sends the document notifications.

requireNoRoomCloses asserts a log substring is absent (roomClosedLine, :1220): a reworded log passes it vacuously. Count closes through the room-counters test hook instead. resumedLine/loggedAt parse slog text the same way.

Fast-follow (cleanup, no behaviour): split room_sync.go catch-up into its own file, the append gate out of pending_authors.go and the conditional-edit queue out of mutation.go; pass storedAhead explicitly rather than through the context; drop the 'At this row's first commit' test paragraphs that describe deleted code; share processPair fixtures.
